Sheth, ([[Managing director|MD]]){{cite web |url=http://www.greatship.com/aboutus/bod.htm |title=GE SHIPPING – About Us – Board of Directors |publisher=Greatship.com |accessdate=2 February 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110711125729/http://www.greatship.com/aboutus/bod.htm |archive-date=11 July 2011 |url-status=dead }}}} | industry = Shipping | products = | services = | revenue = {{INRConvert|42.00|b}}{{cite web|url=http://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/StockReach/AdvanceStockReach.aspx?scripcode=500620 |title=BSE Plus |publisher=Bseindia.com |access-date=2 February 2011}} | operating_income = | net_income = | num_employees = | parent = | subsidiaries = | website = {{official URL}} | caption = }} '''The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited''' (also known as '''GE Shipping''') is an Indian [[Freight transport|shipping]] company which primarily transports liquid, gas and solid bulk products.{{Cite web |last=Lakshmi |first=Aiswarya |date=2018-04-02 |title=GE Shipping to Buy Secondhand VLGC |url=https://www.marinelink.com/news/secondhand-shipping-vlgc435844 |access-date=2023-11-14 |website=MarineLink |language=en}} As of 2023, the company is the largest private sector shipping company in India.{{Cite web |last=Capital Market |date=10 January 2023 |title=GE Shipping rises after subsidiary inks deal to acquire one anchor handler |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/ge-shipping-rises-after-subsidiary-inks-deal-to-acquire-one-anchor-handler-123011000901_1.html |access-date=16 November 2023 |website=Business Standard}} == History == The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited (also known as GE Shipping) was founded by the Sheth family and the Bhiwandiwalla family, who started GE Shipping to assist in expanding the reach of their trading businesses.{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=https://www.greatship.com/about-us.html |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=The Great Eastern Shipping Co. Ltd.}} As of 2023, GE Shipping has over 500 employees.{{Cite web |last=Mehta |first=Praneet |date=2023-08-17 |title=Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited {{!}} 2023 |url=https://www.merchantnavydecoded.com/great-eastern-shipping-company/ |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=Merchant Navy Decoded |language=en-US}} The company is [[Public company|publicly traded]] on India's two main stock exchanges, the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]].{{Cite web |title=Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd. |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/india/stockpricequote/shipping/greateasternshippingcompany/GES |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} == Business segments == GE Shipping's business is divided into two main segments, shipping and offshore.{{Cite web |last=Moneycontrol News |date=2023-08-04 |title=GE Shipping hits 52-week high on strong Q1 earnings, selection of Keki Mistry as director |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/ge-shipping-hits-52-week-high-on-strong-q1-earnings-selection-of-keki-mistry-as-director-11096021.html |access-date=2023-11-15 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} The shipping business is involved in the transportation of [[Petroleum|crude oil]], [[petroleum product]]s, [[Liquefied gas|liquified gas]] and [[Bulk cargo|dry bulk]] commodities.{{Cite web |title=Great Eastern Shipping |url=https://www.forbes.com/companies/great-eastern-shipping/ |access-date=2023-11-15 |website=Forbes |language=en}} The company's offshore business involves conducting offshore exploration and production services, which GE Shipping does by providing exploratory drilling rigs, offshore support vessels and other services, through its wholly owned subsidiary Greatship (India) Limited.{{Cite web |last1=Nagar |first1=Anshul |last2=Sharma |first2=Vipula |date=15 November 2021 |title=The Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd. |url=https://www.brickworkratings.com/Admin/PressRelease/The-Great-Eastern-Shipping-Company-15Nov2021.pdf |access-date=18 November 2023 |website=Brickwork |page=2 }} GE Shipping has been certified SO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015 and ISO 45001: 2018 standards by DNV.GL.{{Cite web |title=Business |url=https://www.greatship.com/business.html |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=The Great Eastern Shipping Co. Ltd}} == Shipping fleet == As of 2022, GE Shipping has a fleet of 42 [[ship]]s, which includes 8 [[Oil tanker|crude tankers]], 18 product carriers, 5 [[gas carrier]]s and 14 dry [[bulk carrier]]s.{{Cite web |last= |date=29 July 2022 |title=The Great Eastern Shipping Q1 FY23 net up 3598 percent at Rs 457 crore - ET Infra |url=https://infra.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/ports-shipping/the-great-eastern-shipping-q1-fy23-net-up-3598-percent-at-rs-457-crore/93218042 |access-date=2023-11-15 |website=ET Infra |language=en}} ==References== [[Category:Shipping companies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Transport companies established in 1948]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1948]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{shipping-company-stub}} {{india-corp-stub}}
extract: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited (also known as GE Shipping) is an Indian shipping company which primarily transports liquid, gas and solid bulk products. As of 2023, the company is the largest private sector shipping company in India.
